title: Enhancing Timing Closure via Spatially Embedded Graph Transformer with Low Power/Area Overhead
problem: Achieving timing closure in advanced technologies is challenging because traditional post-placement optimization fails to account for routing variations, leading to persistent timing violations.
motivation: Accurate timing prediction considering routing effects is essential for reducing design iterations and enabling proactive timing closure.
method: Proposes Spatially Embedded Graph Transformer (SEGT) for timing prediction at placement stage. Incorporates distance-aware self-attention and positional encoding tailored to circuit geometry. Develops preemptive timing closure framework that identifies post-routing violations and adjusts required arrival time to clear each violation.
key_novelty: Graph Transformer with spatial embeddings for routing-aware timing prediction.
contributions: Spatially embedded graph transformer for accurate timing prediction
Distance-aware self-attention capturing non-adjacent node interactions
Reduction in total negative slack with lower power/area overhead
limitations: Evaluation on unspecified test designs; generalization to different technology nodes unclear.
primary_theme: Graph Transformer for routing-aware timing prediction
